Markets.title: Global Markets: French bond spread at highest since 2012 as default insurance spikes
Markets.summary: Risk premiums on French government bonds have surged to their highest levels since the 2012 euro zone debt crisis due to growing investor anxiety over the nation's fiscal health before next year's elections. France is facing a difficult budget situation and plans a major savings initiative to address its rising deficit, which has negatively impacted French banking stocks.

Markets.title: US Treasury yields rise as investors weigh outlook for rate hikes
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields rose due to investor expectations of further Federal Reserve rate hikes and ongoing global inflation pressures. Additionally, the Bank of Japan raised its interest rates to a 31-year high, contributing to a worldwide trend of monetary tightening.

Markets.title: HDFC Mutual Fund buys 13.9 lakh Entero Healthcare shares from Prasid Uno Family Trust in Rs 236 crore block deal
Markets.summary: HDFC Mutual Fund purchased 1.39 million shares of Entero Healthcare Solutions from Prasid Uno Family Trust for Rs 235.6 crore. The transaction was executed through a block deal at Rs 1,695 per share, representing a 3.19% equity stake.

Markets.title: Lenskart block deal: Rs 2,047 crore stake sale likely; Platinum Jasmine may offload 1.7% holding
Markets.summary: Over a five-year period, Bitcoin gained 61.7%, outperforming Ethereum and Solana, which declined 26.2% and 27.9%. Analysts attribute Bitcoin's superior performance to institutional adoption, exchange-traded fund flows, liquidity, and scarcity.

Markets.title: US Federal Reserve's Michelle Bowman says changes to bank stress test coming soon
Markets.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Michelle Bowman announced that the Fed will soon vote on revamped bank stress tests to increase transparency and predictability for lenders. The overhaul will disclose more testing model details to the public and use recent test results to determine capital buffer requirements.

Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks slip as Treasury yields rise, investors weigh Fed outlook
Markets.summary: US stocks fell on Friday due to rising Treasury yields, volatile oil prices, and uncertainty regarding the Federal Reserve's interest rate path. Investors also monitored AI demand concerns, triple witching volatility, and corporate updates involving Warren Buffett and Xenon Pharmaceuticals.

Geo-Political.title: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
Geo-Political.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron stated that Russian hybrid attacks against Europe are increasing. Consequently, he has ordered the government to secure critical infrastructure and defense industry sites.

Geo-Political.title: Three dead and eight injured in Philippines school shooting
Geo-Political.summary: Three people were killed and eight others were injured in a school shooting in the Philippines. The gunman was among the dead in the country's third school shooting since June.

Geo-Political.title: Police begin operation to move migrants from Ceuta beaches
Geo-Political.summary: Police fired shots into the air on Friday morning while trying to control crowds in Ceuta. Officers were attempting to manage migrants jostling for spaces at a tented site during an operation to clear the beaches.

Geo-Political.title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror says he had no doubt she deliberately killed her children
Geo-Political.summary: A holdout juror in the Lindsay Clancy trial has spoken publicly for the first time about his decision. He stated that he had no doubt Clancy deliberately killed her children and refused to acquit her.

Geo-Political.title: At least 17 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
Geo-Political.summary: An explosives-laden vehicle rammed into a Pakistan mosque, killing at least 17 people, including a four-year-old child. Gunmen also opened fire on a nearby police facility during the attack.

Geo-Political.title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member
Geo-Political.summary: A spotted wildcat in Bolivia has been identified as a new species after previously being mistaken for related animals. Only one living member of this newly discovered species is currently known to exist.

Data & Insights.title: India needs more savings, private capital to sustain 7-8% growth, says N.K. Singh
Data & Insights.summary: Former finance commission chairman N.K. Singh stated that India must increase domestic savings and private capital to maintain a 7-8% economic growth rate. He also emphasized the need for improved capital allocation and stronger fiscal coordination between the central and state governments.

Data & Insights.title: Net direct tax collections rise 13% to  ₹12.1 trillion
Data & Insights.summary: Net direct tax collections rose by 13% to ₹12.1 trillion. Meanwhile, net corporate tax collections saw an increase of 19.48% after accounting for refunds.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Why India and Canada are pitching for a CEPA by end-2026
Data & Insights.summary: India and Canada are negotiating a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) to be finalized by the end of 2026. This trade deal aims to strengthen bilateral economic ties following a period of strained political relations between the two nations.

Data & Insights.title: Moody's raises India's fiscal 2027 GDP growth forecast to 7% on Middle East resilience, but risks remain
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's raised India's fiscal year 2027 GDP growth forecast to 7% due to resilience in the Middle East. However, the agency warned that high energy prices and El Niño-related food inflation pose ongoing risks to consumption and growth.

Data & Insights.title: Centre to hold state finance ministers’ conference ahead of GST Council meeting
Data & Insights.summary: The central government will host a conference with state finance ministers on October 7 to discuss financing India's development toward Viksit Bharat. This meeting precedes the upcoming GST Council session and the launch of pre-budget consultations for the 2027-28 Union Budget starting October 12.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi turns 76: Demonetisation, GST, PLI, Jan Dhan and more – Key economic policies rolled out since 2014
Data & Insights.summary: Since taking office in May 2014, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has implemented major economic reforms, including demonetisation, GST, and the PLI scheme. His administration has also driven welfare expansion, technological transformation, national-security shifts, and foreign policy changes.

India.title: Mamata Banerjee Hand-Drew Party Symbol. It's Now Tied To An Indira Gandhi Case
India.summary: The Election Commission's method for settling party symbol disputes dates back to the 1969 Congress split when Prime Minister Indira Gandhi battled the party's old guard. During that historic conflict, the poll body established three specific tests to determine the legitimate ownership of a political symbol.

India.title: On India's Semiconductor Aspirations, Ashwini Vaishnaw's Progress Report
India.summary: At the Semicon India event in New Delhi, Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that India has progressed from mere ambitions to actual project execution. He told NDTV that this successful implementation is building the nation's confidence in its semiconductor industry.

India.title: Exclusive: 16 Months After Op Sindoor, Pak Still Fixing Runway India Broke At Sargodha
India.summary: Sixteen months after Operation Sindoor, Pakistan is still repairing the runway at Sargodha's PAF Base Mushaf that was damaged by India. The air base is located approximately 172 kilometers northwest of Lahore.

India.title: 'Substantial Gaps In Evidence': Supreme Court Sets Aside Life Term Of 4 In Murder Case
India.summary: The Supreme Court overturned the life sentences of four individuals convicted in a murder case due to substantial gaps in the evidence. These four were among six convicted persons who had appealed the High Court's verdict to the top court.

India.title: Is Hyderabad's Viral Ganesha Idol Coated With 24-Carat Gold? Police Clarify
India.summary: Social media posts claimed a viral 48-kilogram Ganesha idol in Hyderabad was coated with 24-carat gold and decorated with hundreds of thousands of diamonds. Police have since clarified the actual composition and value of the idol.

India.title: HAL Hands Over Indigenous Tejas Twin-Seater, HTT-40 Aircraft To Air Force
India.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited handed over indigenous Tejas twin-seater and HTT-40 aircraft to the Indian Air Force. The ceremony took place in the presence of Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and Civil Aviation Minister K Rammohan Naidu.

General.title: 'I'm telling the truth': Earl Spencer defends Diana book claims about Charles in BBC interview
General.summary: In a BBC interview, Earl Spencer defended claims made in his book about Princess Diana. He told Laura Kuenssberg that the then-Prince of Wales literally said "we'll forget her soon enough."

General.title: Watch: Diana's brother says Charles 'went ballistic' in phone call after her death
General.summary: In a new book and interview, Earl Spencer claimed that then-Prince Charles "went ballistic" during a phone call following Princess Diana's death. Spencer shared these details during an exclusive discussion with BBC broadcaster Laura Kuenssberg.

General.title: MI5 accepts it gave evidence based on lies in neo-Nazi spy case
General.summary: MI5 has confirmed for the first time that it provided false evidence in court to defend a violent neo-Nazi informant. This acknowledgment follows a BBC revelation regarding the security service's actions during the spy case.

General.title: Flight chaos caused by software defect in space of a millisecond, report says
General.summary: The failure led to more than 2,000 flights being cancelled and hundreds of thousands of passengers affected.

General.title: Teen who piloted Channel boat with 165 migrants jailed
General.summary: Chan Mathok Atak has been sentenced to two years and three months in prison after piloting the boat.

General.title: Brother didn't match description of 'Putney pusher', suspect's sisters tell BBC
General.summary: The sisters of Nicholas Brandram told the BBC that their brother did not match the description of the "Putney pusher" suspect. They accused the Metropolitan Police of being negligent and reckless in their handling of the matter.
